MBMA Trial Design Grid Heatmap Type

Source: R/type_mbma.R
type_mbma_grid.Rd

Creates simulation matrix heatmaps for clinical trial design exploration (Figure 3A in Serrano et al. 2025). Displays predicted response rates across combinations of baseline covariates (e.g. baseline severity scores), assessment timepoints (e.g. Weeks 8, 12, 16), and trial design policies (e.g. Monotherapy vs. Concomitant TCS). Each cell displays the central percentage in bold with its corresponding ± 95% CI margin underneath.

Usage

type_mbma_grid(
  ci_margin = NULL,
  show_labels = TRUE,
  label_digits = 1,
  palette = c("blues", "teal", "viridis", "sunset"),
  tile_border = "#FFFFFF",
  tile_border_lwd = 0.75,
  text_size = 3.4,
  ci_size = 2.4,
  ...
)

type_trial_design_grid(
  ci_margin = NULL,
  show_labels = TRUE,
  label_digits = 1,
  palette = c("blues", "teal", "viridis", "sunset"),
  tile_border = "#FFFFFF",
  tile_border_lwd = 0.75,
  text_size = 3.4,
  ci_size = 2.4,
  ...
)

Arguments

ci_margin

Column name for confidence interval half-width (margin), or NULL if already formatted or not shown.

show_labels

Logical. Whether to print two-line text annotations inside cells (default TRUE).

label_digits

Number of decimal digits for percentage values (default 1).

palette

Color gradient palette name: "blues" (default), "teal", "viridis", or "sunset".

tile_border

Color for tile dividing gridlines (default "#FFFFFF").

tile_border_lwd

Linewidth for tile borders (default 0.75).

text_size

Numeric text size for cell estimates (default 3.4).

ci_size

Numeric text size for CI margin text (default 2.4).

...

Additional arguments.

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.
